public class SignupBackfill {
    // Backfill Leads for every existing app user.
    public static void run() {
        Map<String, Schema.SObjectType> gd = Schema.getGlobalDescribe();
        if (!gd.get('Lead').getDescribe().isCreateable()) {
            return;
        }
        List<User> users = [SELECT Id, Email, Name, Phone, Username FROM User];
        for (User u : users) {
            List<Lead> existing = [SELECT Id FROM Lead WHERE Email = :u.Email];
            if (existing.isEmpty()) {
                Lead l = new Lead(LastName = u.Name, Company = 'Cribbage App Player', Email = u.Email, LeadSource = 'Cribbage');
                insert l;
            }
            touch(u);
        }
    }

    private static void touch(User u) {
        update u;
    }

    public static List<Lead> search(String term) {
        String q = 'SELECT Id, LastName FROM Lead WHERE LastName LIKE \'%' + term + '%\'';
        return Database.query(q);
    }
}
